title: My kingdom-management roguelite game
author: RadiantExternal8752
selftext:
I'm a solo dev, and my kingdom-management roguelite Fivefold Crown just got a big update. 🛠️

What's new:

• Advisory council: each advisor gives different advice, who do you trust?

• War & diplomacy: you negotiate the peace terms yourself

• Royal journal: your kingdom's story is written as you play

• Better balance between luck and risk

Free in your browser, in English and Turkish. Tell me in the comments how many years you survived and what you liked or didn't. The next update will be shaped by your feedback 🙏

▶ Play free: https://aygforge.itch.io/fivefoldcrown
